title: review_export
description: Collects per-track cutouts and background plates during a recording and publishes a review_assets manifest when the event clip closes.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id written into the manifest.

frame_width.description: Width in pixels of the decoded RGB24 frames; no frames are buffered while this is 0.

frame_height.description: Height in pixels of the decoded RGB24 frames; no frames are buffered while this is 0.

sample_fps.description: Maximum cutout samples per second; 0 or less samples every detection.

cutout_max_edge.description: Longest edge in pixels of each saved cutout.

feather.description: Number of blur passes applied to the cutout mask edge.

ring_size.description: Number of recent frames kept for matching detections to pixels; clamped to 1 through 64.

max_samples.description: Cap on buffered cutout samples per recording; values below 1 become 1.

stream_filter.description: Stream ids to take detections from; empty or absent means all streams.
